desc: Riton's 7 Conquer high performance scope to conquer the most difficult distance shooting. Featuring Riton HD glass, 46 MRAD of internal elevation adjustment, R7 Zero Stop turrets, an integrated throw lever, first focal plane, 1/10 MRAD Windage and Elevation adjustment and 6 levels of red illumination featuring on/off between each level. Includes flip-up lens covers, lens cloth and Allen wrench.
